description: This source file implements the core functions for issuing LAN Protocol Controller (LPC) call requests over TCP within the Ansc (Advanced Networking Service Container) framework. It provides two functions, AnscLpccoTcpImcCallRequest and AnscLpccoTcpImcCallRequest2, which handle establishing connections, resolving parties, and performing remote procedure calls with timeout and error handling.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscLpccoTcpImcCallRequest(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * party_name,void * pInputBuffer,ULONG ulInputSize,ANSC_HANDLE * phOutputBdo,PULONG pulErrorCode,ULONG ulTimeout)
methods.description: Issues an LPC call request to a specified party over TCP, handling connection establishment, party resolution, and message exchange with timeout management.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscLpccoTcpImcCallRequest2(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hPartyAddr,void * pInputBuffer,ULONG ulInputSize,ANSC_HANDLE * phOutputBdo,PULONG pulErrorCode,ULONG ulTimeout)
methods.description: Performs an LPC call request directly to a specified party address, managing connection, message sending, and response handling.
